QuestInfo.name: [Magatia's Secret] De Lang's Potion
QuestInfo.1: #p2111002# confessed his research hasn't taken steps forward these days, but then he lightened up and told me he found a cure for #p2111005#... What? #bA medicine for #p2111005##k? But everything in #p2111002#'s house seemed to have been cleaned out. \n\nIf he didn't try so darndest to hide this, then someone from Alcadno that might have gotten through #p2111002#'s Lab Report. I better go see #b#p2111001##k of Alcadno, since he searched #p2111002#'s whole house.
QuestInfo.2: When I told #p2111001# of #p2111002#, he seemed genuinely shocked.

0.0: Whew... This research is not going anywhere... In fact, it's pretty much all over. I found out that it's practically impossible to transmute the human body with all the memories intact... However, I seem to have stumbled upon something even better.
0.1: This medicine is for my daughter, Keeny. She has always been very weak, you see. I've discovered it's a genetic trait, one I can correct... with this!
0.2: I'm quite proud of this breakthrough. I cannot change humans into machines, but I can give the weak strength. In the long run, this will be a greater benefit to the world, I think. Now that I have shared my breakthrough with you, I must ask you to leave. The lab is still in disarray and I do not need you breaking anything.

no.0: There are really quite a lot of hazards in here. Please get out.

1.0: ...Hey, what brought you back here. ...what? You met with #p2111002#'s afterimage? He mentioned something about #p2111005#'s medicine...?

npc.0: Hmm... This is interesting. Why isn't he banned?
